# Project Context (LLM-optimized)

## Directives
- GRAPH-FIRST: explore code via `specd graph`; grep/glob only non-code or last resort. Stale/missing graph → `specd graph index`.
- `specs/` = requirements SoT; never edit directly. Workflow: draft → implement → review → approve → merge → archive. No code without spec; read/update existing specs; avoid duplicates.
- Artifacts, code, comments, docs English. Full spec: `specd specs context <id>`; include globals with `default:*`.
- TypeScript pnpm ESM monorepo. Hexagonal+DDD: domain no I/O; application ports; infrastructure adapters; rich entities enforce invariants; pure stateless services; manual DI.

## Global Specs — load full via `specd specs context <id>`

### default:_global/architecture
- Business packages: domain → application → infrastructure; inner layers never import outer. Domain no I/O; application uses ports; infrastructure excludes composition.
- Entities own invariants/typed transition errors; value objects expose behavior; stateless domain services are exported functions.
- Ports abstract classes with explicit methods. Constructor DI; no IoC/singletons. Validate external YAML at infrastructure boundary; typed `SpecdError`.
- Composition alone imports infrastructure. `createKernel`, `createKernelBuilder`, capability factories share resolver; canonical `createX(deps)`. Public barrels exclude concrete adapters.
- Adapter packages contain no business logic. Dependencies: plugin-* → skills → core; cli/mcp → sdk; sdk → core|code-graph; schema-* standalone; no cycles. Cross core/graph hosts use `@specd/sdk`.

### default:_global/conventions
- Strict TypeScript; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, ESM NodeNext. Named exports; kebab-case; explicit public returns; no `any`; expected errors use `SpecdError`; immutable domain.

### default:_global/testing
- Vitest; test tree mirrors src; `.spec.ts`; Given/When/Then; no snapshots. Domain/application unit tests mock I/O. Integration uses unique `os.tmpdir()` dirs and cleanup. Ensure cross-platform paths, fixtures, line endings.

### default:_global/docs
- Docs only under `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}`; exceptions: root README, AGENTS, CLAUDE.
- `docs/guide`: title/description/sidebar_position frontmatter; user usage only; configuration/workflows match core; begin with What is SpecD; cover skills, project update, plugins, graph. Keep SDK/package internals outside guide.
- ADR: sequential `NNNN-kebab-case`, MADR, Decision Outcome Confirmation + More Information/Spec; link source specs only.
- Every CLI command needs docs/cli page, index, sidebar; MCP schemas/examples in docs/mcp. Public symbols need full JSDoc.
- Hosts document/import `@specd/sdk` only. SDK collections under `docs/sdk/{core,code-graph,skills,schemas}` require frontmatter. Update affected docs for public composition, template/config cascades, list-contract changes.

### default:_global/eslint
- Type-aware TypeScript: forbid any/default exports; require explicit returns, kebab-case, JSDoc, layer boundaries. Lint before commit.

### default:_global/continuous-integration
- CI on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows for PR+main; pnpm 10.6.5, Node 22, frozen install; build → typecheck → test.

### default:_global/error-handling-conventions
- Expected user failures: `SpecdError`, `specd=true`, UPPER_SNAKE code, actionable message, JSON/TOON metadata.

### default:_global/logging
- Console-compatible `log/info/debug/warn/error`; info for normal events; fatal/trace through error/debug prefixes; abstraction over raw console.

findings.reason: Implementation depends on entry files and binds no declaration, but no test asserts the namespace package import scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Add indexing test for namespace package import

findings.title: Prepare read-once not asserted
findings.reason: prepareWorkspaceManifest memoizes per codeRoot and entrySurface reads from session, but tests only check manifests are available (and survive deletion), not a single read per workspace.

evidence.detail: Several workspaces prepare test, no read count

findings.title: Namespace package import has no test
findings.reason: Package-boundary namespace scenario (13) is the intended target of the earlier occurrence.

findings.title: Prepare read-once not asserted
findings.reason: Scenario 19 (prepare reads once) has no read-count assertion.

findings.title: Manifest change to importer rebuild not asserted end-to-end
findings.reason: Only a fingerprint unit test shows exports/manifest change alters the fingerprint; no indexer-level test asserts the importing workspace result equals a clean rebuild after a target manifest change.

findings.title: Newly added workspace case untested
findings.reason: Test at index-code-graph.package-imports.spec.ts:599 re-adds a missing file in a configured workspace; it does not add a previously unconfigured workspace in an incremental run.

findings.title: No assertion that closure avoids reading unrelated files
findings.reason: Closure uses persisted steps/bindings (collectAffectedFileClosure) but no test asserts unrelated files are not read or re-extracted.

findings.title: No test for duplicate package identity error
findings.reason: Spec requires an error naming both workspaces when two workspaces claim one package identity; implementation emits it but no test asserts it.

findings.title: Manifest change and new-workspace closure untested at indexer level
findings.reason: Incremental tests cover entry, barrel, importer and target-file addition; none changes a package manifest or adds a workspace between runs (manifest change relies on fingerprint-mismatch full rebuild).

evidence.detail: incremental cases at L315-L357 and L599

findings.title: Constraints delta drops still-valid baseline constraints
findings.reason: The Constraints delta is op modified with full-section content, so merged Constraints keeps only 4 bullets and drops all 13 baseline bullets (incl. store lifecycle, normalized paths, excludePaths defaults, Pass1-before-Pass2, per-file errors collected). The delta description only mentions language independence and design.md does not retire these; implementation still honors them (e.g. per-file errors collected at index-code-graph.ts Pass 2 catch). Likely authoring error: use append/preserve.

evidence.detail: Pass 2 per-file catch pushes to errors (~1318)

findings.recommendation: Rewrite delta to keep baseline constraints (or explicitly justify each removal) and add the new bullets

findings.title: No test for positive name resolution via package __init__.py
findings.reason: Scenario requires 'from acme_auth import make_client' to resolve to a name declared in acme_auth/__init__.py; existing Python tests only exercise __init__ as a re-import alias (unresolved) and a module import.

evidence.detail: Python tests at lines 76 and 110 never declare a name in __init__.py
Python entry surface returns __init__ (line 252) but not name binding

findings.title: No test deletes pyproject.toml before Python entrySurface
findings.reason: Scenario requires entrySurface to still resolve after pyproject.toml files are deleted; Python entrySurface tests use a session only and never delete manifests (TypeScript has such a test, Python does not). Implementation is fs-free by inspection.

evidence.detail: Python entry surface block lines 234-284 lacks the manifest-deleted assertion (TS analog at line 180)

findings.title: No test asserts re-export linking reads no file
findings.reason: linkReExports only uses session state, but no test spies on filesystem access while link() runs.

evidence.detail: link tests assert bindings, not absence of I/O

findings.title: No test that a facet does not imply a capability flag
findings.reason: No test asserts that an adapter providing reExportLinking without hierarchy provenance cannot advertise hierarchy; conformance only checks advertised capabilities produce output.

findings.title: Identity collision untested
findings.reason: No test builds two workspaces with the same package identity and asserts the error naming both workspaces.

evidence.detail: package identity collision error near line 898

findings.title: Hydrated workspace prepare untested
findings.reason: Incremental tests compare graph snapshots but none asserts prepare receives every workspace including unchanged ones; the order test only checks one prepare call.

evidence.detail: prepare call with packageWorkspaces near line 1208
order test near line 359 records no workspace list

findings.title: Unimported type workspace lookup unasserted
findings.reason: No located test asserts that an unimported parameter type name still targets the single same-workspace symbol after the import change.

evidence.detail: only import-wins and cross-workspace cases found

findings.title: Throwing identity does not disable the packageResolution facet for the run
findings.reason: Spec and design require an adapter whose identity, prepare or link throws to be treated as facet-absent for the rest of the run. prepare and link failures add the adapter to disabledPackageResolution, but the identity catch only records an error and continues, so the adapter still gets prepare and matchSpecifier and is not listed in adaptersWithoutPackageResolution.

evidence.detail: identity catch pushes error and continues without disabledPackageResolution.add
identity/prepare/link failures treat adapter as having no facet
identity throw test asserts only error recorded and run completes

findings.recommendation: Add the adapter to disabledPackageResolution in the identity catch and assert it in the test

findings.title: Garbled sentence in Resolution manifests rule
findings.reason: Merged text reads Package identity and the package identity comes from the module path; intent is unambiguous editing artifact.

findings.title: Throwing identity does not disable the adapter's packageResolution facet
findings.reason: Scenario requires an adapter whose identity, prepare, or link throws to be treated as lacking the facet for the rest of the run. prepare and link failures add the adapter to disabledPackageResolution, but an identity failure only records an error and continues, so matchSpecifier/entrySurface stay active and the adapter is not listed in adaptersWithoutPackageResolution.

evidence.detail: identity catch pushes error and continue without disabledPackageResolution.add (prepare 1218 and link 1232 do add)
Facet that throws in identity, prepare, or link does not stop the run

findings.title: Link-throw and identity-disables-facet not asserted
findings.reason: Tests cover prepare throwing (adapter treated as absent) and identity throwing (error recorded, run completes), but none asserts the adapter is treated as absent after an identity failure, and no test makes reExportLinking.link throw.

evidence.detail: prepare-throw test; identity-throw test at 496 only checks error and completion

findings.title: entrySurface does not itself exclude test files
findings.reason: Scenario says entrySurface does not return a candidate classified as a test. TypeScript entryCandidatePaths filters only on indexed status; the exclusion is applied afterwards by PackageImportResolver.entryFiles (session.getFileCategory). Observable behavior through the indexer satisfies it, but the facet contract as written is not met at the facet level; indexer spec phrases it as helper filtering.

evidence.detail: Test files are not entries (helper filters entries)

findings.title: No type-level test that former loose methods are absent
findings.reason: Scenario states a type-level test checks LanguageAdapter declares none of the former loose methods and TypeScript adapter facet objects; only the missing qualifiedNameResolution is checked (package-resolution.spec.ts:450). No test references the removed method names.

findings.title: Go facet omission not asserted
findings.reason: No test asserts the Go adapter exposes no relativeImportResolution or qualifiedNameResolution (scenarios 0015/0017 equivalent for Go).

findings.title: Prepare receiving hydrated workspaces untested
findings.reason: Prepare-once is asserted (spec:402), but no incremental test asserts prepare receives every configured workspace including hydrated-only ones; implementation passes all options.workspaces so behavior appears correct.

findings.title: Provenance path of cross-workspace import not asserted
findings.reason: Only resolved status and target id are asserted for an import:package step; no test checks the ordered path local binding, import:package step, public binding, logical target.

evidence.detail: asserts status and target id only

findings.title: Step following tested only with stub language
findings.reason: No resolver test follows import:package steps from TypeScript, Python, Go, and PHP files; only the made-up stub adapter is exercised. Implementation has no language branch (generic step tracing).

findings.title: resolveToPath targets unindexed absolute paths and multi-PSR-4 filter never matches
findings.reason: Spec says an unindexed file is never targeted. With a single PSR-4 candidate resolveQualifiedNameFromSession returns the absolute path unchecked. With several candidates it filters by session.getFileId on absolute paths, but session files are workspace-prefixed (ws:rel), so it never matches and returns undefined. The resolveImports own-PSR-4 fallback has the same absolute-path getFileId check, so it can never succeed.

evidence.detail: candidates[0] returned without index check; getFileId on absolute candidates
asserts unindexed absolute path is returned
